item.title: Encrypted Weekly Backups to Dropbox with restic and rclone on Ubuntu 24.04
item.description: Set up encrypted, deduplicated weekly backups from Ubuntu 24.04 to Dropbox using restic, rclone and a systemd user timer — including how to restore when you actually need it.
